title: PER.DY.------C.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 133 (AE(PD)-21). PER-DY (perception dynamics) is the subject; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: AFI (affinity insight), MT-INFO (multi-information), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and TRS (transition). From MT-INFO: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From TRS: ACT (activism). From EXB-H-OR: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From ACT: AF-CY and ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism).
